newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Resource buys two competitors.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Resource buys two competitors.

text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc. said Monday it has definitive agreements to acquire its two largest competitors, American Ophthalmic Inc. and the eye care division of EquiMed Inc. in separate deals worth about $124 million.

The acquisitions will make Physicians Resource the nation's largest single-speciality physician practice management company, with annual revenues of about $378 million, it said. It will serve 136 ophthalmic and optometric practices and have 586 professionals and 44 ambulatory surgery centres.

Physicians Resource said it will acquire substantially all of the assets and liabilities of EquiMed's eye care division for $54 million in cash. The price will increase if EquiMed acquires and transfers other ophthalmic and optometric practices to Physicians Resource through March 1997.

The Dallas-based company said it will pay about $70 million for American Ophthalmic, a private company based in Winter Park, Fla. Half is expected to be paid in cash, with the rest paid with about 1.4 million shares of common stock.
Up to $10 million of the total purchase price is subject to delivery of letters of intent relative to acquisitions during the next several months.
The American Ophthalmic transaction is subject to an escrow arrangement and will be accounted for as a purchase. Both deals are expected to close within 60 days.

EquiMed's eye care division provides practice management services to about 21 eye care practices, 10 ambulatory surgery centres and 73 eye care professionals in Louisiana, Illinois, Iowa, California, Pennsylvania, Missouri, Arkansas, Kentucky and New York. The Tucker, Ga.-based company will retain a physician management division specialising in oncology.

American Ophthalmic provides practice management services to about 16 eye care practices, nine ambulatory surgery centres and 102 eye care professionals in Florida, Alabama, Nevada, California, Texas and North Carolina.
Physicians Resource's stock rose $2.125 to $24.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading. EquiMed was unchanged at $8.125 on Nasdaq.
